about_the_game:
A first-person horror game focused on survival and constant tension.
Trapped in an isolated rural town, you must find a way to escape while being hunted by a savage creature — an unpredictable, fast, and deadly werewolf.

With no effective weapons and limited resources, your only defense is the environment around you.
Run. Hide. Improvise.
Every step could be your last — the enemy hears your movements, smells your presence, and never stops hunting.

  • Explore abandoned houses, ruined buildings, and empty streets

  • Find escape routes and uncover clues about what happened in the town

  • Use light, sound, and your surroundings to survive

  • Face a dynamic AI enemy that actively searches for and adapts to the player

Is it possible to fight back?
Find out — if you can survive the night.

short_description: Trapped in a rural town and hunted by a relentless werewolf, your only chance is to run, hide, and survive. No weapons, no help—just you against the night. Use your instincts and the environment to escape before it finds you.
